message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Auto-fix Code Quality Issues

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Generate GitHub App Token
        id: app-token
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name || github.repository }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref }}

      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22.x"

      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-npm-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm install
          npm install --no-save @biomejs/cli-linux-x64@2.0.4 @rspack/binding-linux-x64-gnu@1.5.8

      - name: Run Biome check (fork PRs)
        id: biome-check
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token == ''
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          npm run lint 2>&1 | tee biome-output.txt
          exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}

      - name: Show Biome fix instructions (fork PRs)
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token == '' && steps.biome-check.outcome == 'failure'
        run: echo "::warning::Biome check found issues. Please run 'npm run lint' locally and push the fixes."

      - name: Run Biome lint and format
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token != ''
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run Knip check (fork PRs)
        id: knip-check
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token == ''
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run knip

      - name: Show Knip fix instructions (fork PRs)
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token == '' && steps.knip-check.outcome == 'failure'
        run: echo "::warning::Knip found unused exports/dependencies. Please run 'npm run knip:fix' locally and push the fixes."

      - name: Run Knip fix
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token != ''
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run knip:fix

      - name: Check for changes and last author
        id: check-changes
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token != ''
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "changes_detected=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            LAST_AUTHOR=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:'%an')
            LAST_COMMIT_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:'%s')

            if [ "$LAST_AUTHOR" == "better-lyrics-harmonizer[bot]" ] && [ "$LAST_COMMIT_MSG" == "Auto-fix: Apply Biome and Knip fixes" ]; then
              echo "::error::Infinite loop detected: Bot found more changes after its own auto-fix. Manual intervention required."
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "changes_detected=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.app-token.outputs.token != '' && steps.check-changes.outputs.changes_detected == 'true'
        uses: planetscale/ghcommit-action@v0.2.19
        with:
          commit_message: "Auto-fix: Apply Biome and Knip fixes"
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `npm install` on every run with no dependency cache, while a package-lock.json exists and CI history shows repeated successful runs. This matches P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads): cache the npm download state keyed on the lockfile, preserving the existing install command and all build/test/fix steps. Permissions are unchanged (contents: write is still required for the commit/push step), no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, or new network access are added, and no existing cache is present to conflict with.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
